title: Classic Farm Animals
description: TIRED OF [Temperature-Based Livestock]? Restore the classic cows, pigs, chickens, eggs, (and more) from [[before]] 26.1!!!
body:
# [[CLASSIC FARM ANIMALS]]

FIRST THEY SPLIT THE FARM ANIMALS.

THEN THEY REMODELED THE BABIES.

IT HAD TO STOP.

## [[CLASSIC FARM ANIMALS]]

THIS RESOURCE PACK RESTORES THE CLASSIC PRE-1.21.5 AND PRE-26.1 APPEARANCE OF MINECRAFT'S FARM ANIMALS.

NO MORE [Warm Cow].

NO MORE [Cold Pig].

NO MORE [Different Chicken Egg].

NO MORE [[BABY UNCOOKED CHICKEN KERNEL POPPING INTO AN ADULT CHICKEN POPCORN]].

### [[FEATURES]]

Cold cow, pig, and chicken variants changed to temperate

Warm cow, pig, and chicken variants changed to temperate

Chicken eggs restored to the classic temperate variant

Reverts baby cows to their pre-26.1 appearance

Reverts baby pigs to their pre-26.1 appearance

Reverts baby chickens to their pre-26.1 appearance

JUST THE CLASSIC FARM ANIMALS YOU REMEMBER.

AS THE [[ANCIENT FARMERS]] INTENDED.
